issue.title: bob-cli artifact-link event store invalid: operation_id reuse blocks publication/drain/reconcile
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `gh_bobs-org__bob-cli` artifact-link event store (operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c reused for different artifact link events)

Repro: run the housekeeping artifact_link_backfill chop; bob-cli publication, drain and reconcile fail every tick with operation_id reuse error. Found during plan:202609/artifact_link_backfill_reconcile_timeout.md profiling; out of scope for the timeout fix.

Impact: bob-cli never publishes/drains/reconciles; blocks its artifact-link pipeline every tick.

task_type_fields.repro: Run artifact_link_backfill chop; observe operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c reuse error on every tick

issue.creation_reason: Plan artifact_link_backfill_reconcile_timeout follow-up 1; filing per plan section 5 after dedupe found no duplicate.

payload.entry: Supplementary evidence from the sase-1fs landing on 2026-10-05, not a fresh reproduction of the operation_id collision. `sase agent sync -p bob-cli --check --refresh` returned state ready, ahead 0, behind 2, and no quarantine diagnostics. Apollo's agents-publication-outbox.json has zero items. Remote agents main 68c0b39 includes later sync commits from Apollo and Athena, so agent-page publication is flowing. artifact_link_backfill was not re-run, so this does not show that operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c is gone. The Oct 3 recovery still recorded that collision (sase-1fs.3). The same store failure is already a DISCOVERED ISSUE on sase-yy.8.6.
